property_summary: After SetLogFile(log) is called by a contract caller H, any later Put by H must still succeed because LogFile points to the supplied log contract; the mutant stores H itself as LogFile, so Put's LogFile.AddMessage call reverts for some deposit amounts.
change_summary: Replace the assignment 'LogFile = Log(_log);' with 'LogFile = Log(msg.sender);' so the stored LogFile address is the caller rather than the argument.
